datasets.name: WebSight (HuggingFaceM4/WebSight)
datasets.use: 3,000 screenshots already on this machine, read as a second "average generated page" pole for the image singularity check. Not redistributed, not used for training.

datasets.name: openai/clip-vit-base-patch32
datasets.use: image embeddings for the singularity and diversity measures; inference only

excluded.name: Preline UI (htmlstreamofficial/preline)
excluded.reason: Dual licence: MIT plus the "Preline UI Fair Use License", which forbids use in a product that competes with Preline UI and puts conditions on templates and page builders. A design editor with building blocks is too close to that line. Cloned to read the licence only; nothing studied or used.

excluded.name: Astroship (surjithctly/astroship)
excluded.reason: GPL-3.0: copyleft, incompatible with shipping in an MIT application.

excluded.name: Cruip tailwind-landing-page-template
excluded.reason: No licence file detected by GitHub (NONE); Cruip free templates are historically GPL. Not used.

excluded.name: davidgrzyb/tailwind-admin-template
excluded.reason: Licence not recognised by GitHub (NOASSERTION); not verified, not used.

excluded.name: withastro/astro example templates
excluded.reason: GitHub reports NOASSERTION for the repository (MIT text with additional third-party notices). Not verified file by file, so not used; AstroWind (MIT) covers the Astro template case.

excluded.name: Radix Themes (radix-ui/themes)
excluded.reason: MIT and usable, but not cloned or studied in this prototype, so it is not claimed as a source.

excluded.name: nextjs/saas-starter, vercel/commerce, Starlight, AstroPaper, accessible-astro-starter, Notus JS, Ionic
excluded.reason: MIT according to GitHub; licence checked but not studied, so not claimed as sources.

excluded.name: Tailwind Plus (Tailwind UI) and its templates
excluded.reason: Commercial licence that forbids redistribution and use in builders.

excluded.name: Figma Community files
excluded.reason: Each file carries its own licence (often CC BY 4.0, sometimes none stated) and Figma's community terms; none was verified file by file, so none was used.

excluded.name: Mobbin
excluded.reason: Paid, no licence to reuse; excluded by instruction.

excluded.name: Design galleries and crawled sites (Awwwards, Godly, Land-book, Dribbble, Behance…)
excluded.reason: No licence to reuse, automated access forbidden by their terms; excluded by instruction. Nothing was crawled for this prototype.

excluded.name: Flowbite Blocks (flowbite.com/blocks)
excluded.reason: The marketing blocks on the website are not in the MIT repository and their free/pro terms were not verified. Only the MIT repository documentation was read.
